items.headline: 'Bright kid:' Mother shares grief after son dies in Colonie house fire
items.excerpt: As the investigation continues into Friday evening's fatal house fire in Colonie, the mother of the 6-year-old child who died, shared her grief on Monday. She said his name was Kavon Junior, and he meant everything to her.

items.headline: Rally calls for more disability funding in the New York State Budget
items.excerpt: Advocates and care workers gathered at the New York state Capitol on Monday to demand increased funding for disability services in the 2027/2028 state budget.

items.headline: Albany to vote on proposed budget after financial shortfalls
items.excerpt: Albany city leaders could vote on a proposed 2027 budget tonight. The city had to borrow $10 million to get through this year, but that won't help in the long run.

items.headline: New York receives C- in new infrastructure report
items.excerpt: The American Society of Civil Engineers released its 2026 infrastructure report, which grades systems like roads, ports, transit, wastewater and more based on their condition, capacity, safety and resilience.

items.headline: Hochul pushed to codify PFAS limits, skirt federal rollback
items.excerpt: Democratic State Senator Pat Fahy met with environmental advocates at the New York State Capitol to urge Governor Kathy Hochul to sign legislation that would establish stricter state limits on PFAS in drinking water to counteract potential federal rollbacks under the Trump administration.

items.headline: Boston Red Sox vice chairman gifts $5M to Glens Falls YMCA
items.excerpt: Boston Red Sox Vice Chairman Phillip Morse, a resident of the Capital Region, donated $5 million to the Saratoga Regional YMCA, the gym announced Monday.
